name: Xenios Admin CRM and Supplier Operations

safetyAndAuthority.storageScoping: The route factory resolves a storage actor from server-verified admin identity. Integration must supply an RLS-scoped repository; no client identity grants authority.
safetyAndAuthority.trustDial: Consequential actions read the server-side Trust Dial. never refuses; ask becomes awaiting_approval; queue and auto still create queue records in this pack.
safetyAndAuthority.outboundApproval: The intake bridge never replies. Buyer and tracking follow-ups create approval-queue requests only.
safetyAndAuthority.moneyBoundary: The workspace cannot capture, accept, verify, void, or refund money.
safetyAndAuthority.wellnessBoundary: Operational projections fail closed when health, diagnosis, medication, prescription, biometric, assessment, blueprint, or clinical keys appear.
safetyAndAuthority.audit: The repository contract exposes no unaudited write; queue item and audit event must be committed atomically. Mail intake and observed audit must also be atomic.

integrationRequired: Rebase or recreate the slice on the integration head that contains the accepted Pack 01-04 work.
Implement AdminCrmSupplierOperationsRepository with storage-layer scoping, RLS, transactionally atomic action-plus-audit writes, and no restricted wellness projection.
Wire registerAdminCrmSupplierOperationsApi behind the existing requireSupabaseAdmin guard and a server-side admin-actor resolver.
Wire the mailbox provider to createResearchMailboxIntakeBridge with provider authentication, replay protection, and atomic intake-plus-audit persistence.
Add a new admin route and navigation entry for CrmSupplierOperations only after the API repository is ready.
Keep the existing Operations Command Center and Mitch Portal mounted and unchanged.
environmentNotes: The checkout used Node 24/npm 11 while package.json pins Node 20.19/npm 10.8.2; the production build and type-check still passed.
